test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following the constitutional powers and duties in relation to the accounts of Union and of the central government?

options.text: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Comptroller and Auditor General of India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)** is responsible for auditing the accounts of the Union and state governments and public sector organizations.
 
• The CAG is an independent authority established by the Constitution of India under **Article 148**.
 
• He is responsible for ensuring that public funds are used efficiently and for the purposes intended by Parliament.
 
• The CAG submits audit reports to the President of India, who then places them before both houses of Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The CAG is appointed by the President of India and can only be removed from office in a manner similar to that of a Supreme Court judge, ensuring independence.
 
• The office of the CAG is considered one of the pillars of the democratic system of government in India.
 
• The CAG's reports are taken into consideration by the Public Accounts Committees (PACs) of the Parliament and state legislatures for scrutiny and action.
 
• The CAG also advises on the accounting system and form of accounts of the Union and states.
